Package org.apache.juneau.petstore.service

Class PendingChanges

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.petstore.service.PendingChanges
public class PendingChanges extends Object
The staging area for pet-detail inline edits: edits are staged here instead of mutating the pet, then applied (perRow, with retry on failure) or discarded (aggregate) from the Pending changes page.

Obtained from PetStore.pendingChanges(). All methods are synchronized; the store is a demo, not a transactional system.

Example:

PendingChanges pc = store.pendingChanges(); PendingChange c = pc.stage(1, "price", "42.50", "alice"); pc.stage(1, "status", "SOLD", "alice"); pc.apply(c.getId(), "console:alice"); // pet 1 now costs 42.50 PendingChanges.DiscardOutcome out = pc.discard(List.of("7", "8"), "console:alice");

  • Method Details

    • stage

      public PendingChange stage(long petId, String field, String newValue, String author)
      Stages an edit without touching the pet.
      Parameters:
      petId - The pet id.
      field - One of "name", "price", "species", "status" or "tags" (tags is a comma-separated list; blank clears).
      newValue - The new value (string form).
      author - Who staged it.
      Returns:
      The new pending change.
      Throws:
      PetstoreNotFoundException - If the pet does not exist.
      IllegalArgumentException - If the field is not stageable or the value is invalid.

    • apply

      public PendingChange apply(long id, String actor)
      Writes a pending change to its pet. If the pet is gone, the change becomes FAILED instead.
      Parameters:
      id - The change id.
      actor - The audit actor.
      Returns:
      The change, now APPLIED or FAILED.
      Throws:
      PetstoreNotFoundException - If the change does not exist.
      PetstoreConflictException - If the change is not pending.

      public PendingChange retry(long id, String actor)
